final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---------------- bias (IREF = 10uA into ibias) ----------------
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss  nfet W=1  L=2    m=10
MB1  inp   ibias vss  vss  nfet W=1  L=2    m=1
MB2  inn   ibias vss  vss  nfet W=1  L=2    m=1
MB3  pb    ibias vss  vss  nfet W=1  L=2    m=2
MPB0 pb    pb    vin  vin  pfet W=4  L=1    m=1
MPT  tail  pb    vin  vin  pfet W=4  L=1    m=2
* ---------------- input level shift (-0.3 V both sides) --------
Rs1  vref  inp   300k
Cs1  inp   vss   2p
Rs2  fb    inn   300k
Cs2  fb    inn   2p
* ---------------- current-mirror OTA ---------------------------
MPA  n1    inp   tail tail pfet W=10 L=0.5  m=4
MPB  n2    inn   tail tail pfet W=10 L=0.5  m=4
MN1  n1    n1    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=2    m=1
MN2  n2    n2    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=2    m=1
MN3  p3    n1    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=2    m=6
MN4  vg    n2    vss  vss  nfet W=4  L=2    m=6
MP3  p3    p3    vin  vin  pfet W=4  L=1    m=6
MP4  vg    p3    vin  vin  pfet W=4  L=1    m=6
* ---------------- pass device ----------------------------------
MPASS vout vg    vin  vin  pfet W=20 L=0.18 m=200
* ---------------- feedback divider (fb = 0.6 V) ----------------
R1   vout  fb    28571
R2   fb    vss   30k
Cf   vout  fb    5p
* ---------------- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
Cc   vg    cz    50p
Rz   cz    vout  11k
.ends
